blocks.text: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Monday said it issued a show cause order (SCO) and directed a social media personality to surrender his driver’s license after he was caught on video riding a motorcycle without wearing a helmet. Although the LTO did not identify Rendon Labador in the statement they issued as the personality they were referring to, the agency posted a partially blurred image of the vlogger. The same photo of Labador without facial blur was previously shared by Transportation Assistant Secretary Gabriel Go on his social media account on Nov. 21.
